provenance.method: Page types from each sheet's header line (every sheet of the compilation is a log sheet, headed by the delivery file name and depth range). Sampled boreholes: values copied from the PDF text layer with bench/tools/draft_jp_denshi.py, checked by internal consistency on every sheet (elevation = ground level - depth, thickness = base - top, N column against blows and penetration) and against the page image where a check failed or a test ran across a sheet break.

scope.sample_rule: The log on every 100th page: the boreholes whose sheets include pages 1, 101, 201, ..., 1201 (13 of the 833 logs).

layers.description: 玉石混じり砂質礫(盛土)

readiness.note: Every sampled log gives latitude and longitude; the compilation spans many sites across the prefecture, so a model is a regional one.
